name: CloningScenarios
description: CloningScenarios is an expert-level multi-step reasoning benchmark about difficult genetic cloning scenarios in multiple-choice format. It evaluates dual-use biological knowledge relevant to bioweapons development.
reputation: A niche, safety-sensitive benchmark with limited public adoption, mainly of interest to biosecurity researchers rather than the broader ML community.
notes: Dual-use biology content; likely small and specialized, with potential contamination concerns and restricted practical use due to biosecurity sensitivity.
